name: shopsavvy
description: Shopping research and price comparison from ShopSavvy (tens of millions of products, prices from tens of thousands of retailers, price history back to 2011), plus Data API skills for developers: competitor price reports, price-history exports and retailer coverage checks. Works without an API key; a ShopSavvy Data API key is optional and raises the rate limit.

api_key.title: ShopSavvy Data API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave blank to use ShopSavvy free (10 tool calls a minute, 100 an hour). Paste a Data API key from shopsavvy.com/data to raise the limit to 100 a minute; calls then use your plan's credits.
